cells.quote: "Students in OGAP schools scored significantly higher than peers on the Pennsylvania state math test (PSSA), with an effect size of +0.20 across two years."
cells.note: No study text is available; quote copied from the wiki entry.

cells.quote: "The student population was racially diverse (about half Black, 17% Hispanic, 10% Asian), with nearly 70% eligible for free or reduced-price lunch."
cells.note: No study text is available. The wiki entry reports only descriptive characteristics of a two-year RCT sample in grades 3–5; it reports no treatment-versus-comparison contrast, outcome finding, or effect size. Age and duration are inferred from the entry's grades 3–5 and two-year description.

O.outcome_detail: diagnostic value for measuring general ability

cells.quote: The problems may now be ranked in diagnostic value according to the slope of the curve at the 50% point. Thus it will be seen that the diagnostic value of Problem 8 appears to be the best.
cells.note: The study compares test items using their pass patterns among 121 individuals ranked by total point score; it does not manipulate learning conditions.

cells.quote: In the latter tests, the Columbia freshmen score 44.5 as over against 35.0 for this group.
cells.note: Descriptive comparison of group norms; no inferential test or effect size is reported.

cells.quote: The median score, 211.6, is not far below the score of 220.4 given by Wells10 as typical for a normal individual near the limit of practice.
cells.note: Descriptive comparison of norms; no inferential test or effect size is reported.

cells.quote: In the cancellation test we find a much wider range and a lower central tendency than Woodworth and Wells found (p. 29).
cells.note: Because cancellation time is the outcome, the lower central tendency indicates faster performance. The study reports no inferential test or effect size.

cells.quote: The same may be said for the results in the color-naming test, and the tests in logical relations. In each of these types of mental task, the freshman mind seems to work rapidly.
cells.note: The preceding sentence states that Dartmouth freshmen had a lower central tendency than the comparison group; for color-naming time, lower indicates faster performance. No inferential test or effect size is reported.
